name: Europapas intro
description: The Red Nova Conspiracy — authored via @neocompose/cli.

e4.say: Take this abyssal lantern. Light that works under ice works in any shadow — and you're headed where the sun itself is being stolen from.

e2.say: Strange? Tankers sinking heat-exchangers straight through our crust. Dumping waste heat from something HUGE they're running out by Saturn. Our ocean's a degree warmer. A DEGREE.

e1.say: Shhh. You'll scare the deepfish. ...Topside business, is it?

options.label: Ask
options.text: Have you seen anything strange under the ice?

e2b.say: Patient one, eh? The deepfish like you. So do I. Listen close, then:
